content:
With new Collaborative Posts you can credit everyone whose worked on a post, project, milestone, or moment. Because we know some of the most interesting ideas on LinkedIn aren't coming from a single voice, but from people building something special together. And who better to put them to the test than Natalie (Corporate Natalie) and Ross Pomerantz?
 
Feature access will roll out over the next few weeks, so if you don't have it yet, stay tuned!
comment: Collaborative credit can also improve accountability. The key will be making contributions visible without creating confusion around ownership, especially on complex projects with many stakeholders.
